Subject: Aptaro PO C kickoff — recap + asks (Hosted vs Dedicated vs Private)

Thanks again for a productive call this morning. Quick recap and next steps so we have a shared plan heading into procurement: 

Summary of ask
- Primary product: real-time assistant across customer support and internal knowledge base.
- SLO: 95th pct latency target ~1200ms for complete response, with soft 500ms token-stream start target.
- Traffic profile (requested confirmation below): baseline ~30 rps, expected growth to sustained ~100 rps within 6 months; burst up to ~300 rps for short windows.
- Token mix: mixed — short prompts (70%), medium (25%), long/doc retrieval (5%). Average end-to-end tokens per request estimate: ~420 tokens.
- Data residency: US only. Compliance: SOC2 required, potential audit.

Deployment options discussed
- Hosted API: fastest to go-live, lower operational burden; can demo within 48 hours using Redwood-hosted runtime.
- Dedicated capacity: predictable throughput and data isolation, recommended for sustained 100 rps+ and strict latency SLOs.
- Private VPC/on-prem: considered if procurement/regulatory requires customer-controlled network and KMS.

Immediate asks for sizing and proposal
1) Can you confirm the realistic sustained TPS/RPS and percentile token distributions (our numbers are above)?
2) Any specific latency SLO you must meet at 95th/99th? 1200ms is our working assumption.
3) Are there internal security/compliance contacts we should loop into the SOC2 / private deployment conversation?
4) Attachment: aptaro_poc_requirements_v1.pdf — please review and flag gaps.

Proposed next steps
- Sofia to confirm traffic & token distribution (by EOD Tue).
- Redwood (Priyom + Marcus) to return a dedicated-capacity sizing stub and pricing by Thu, including A100 vs H100 tradeoffs and recommended concurrency/kv-cache settings.
- If Aptaro prefers Hosted for pilot, we’ll provision a short-term Hosted demo and quantify delta to Dedicated for path to production.

Thanks — Marcus
Marcus Lin

Subject: Redwood sizing recommendation (Dedicated) — A100 vs H100, concurrency & caching

Sofia / team — based on Marcus's recap and Sofia's confirmed telemetry, here's a concise sizing and technical tradeoff note for Aptaro's Dedicated pool. Attaching the pricing spreadsheet (redwood-dedicated-pricing-proposal.xlsx).

Key inputs we used
- Sustained RPS: 95 rps (business hours)
- Peak burst: 260 rps (8-minute windows)
- Concurrency observed: ~220 concurrent during peaks
- Avg tokens per request: ~420
- Latency targets: 95th <= 1.2s, 99th <= 2.5s

Recommendation (short)
- Provisioning: 2 x H100 (80GB) nodes in a dedicated pool with autoscale policies for burst capacity up to +1 node. Rationale: H100 gives a material throughput and latency edge for long-sequence decode workloads and mixed-precision kernels; for Aptaro's token mix the extra memory and faster kernels reduce batching pressure during bursts.
- Alternative (cost-sensitive): 3 x A100 (80GB) nodes. Slightly higher operational batching complexity, but lower per-hour cost; better if Aptaro is cost-first.
- Concurrency & batching settings: target 1.5–2.0k tokens per GPU batch; continuous batching with a 15–25ms micro-batch delay to balance latency vs throughput. We recommend enabling KV prefix caching for repeated retrieval prompts to cut downstream token counts by up to ~15–25% on retrieval hits.
- Expected steady-state latency (95th) on 2xH100: ~900–1,100ms with proper batching and cache hit rates; on 3xA100: ~1,100–1,400ms. 99th percentiles trend 2x but still within your 2.5s target if we tune queueing.

Operational notes / asks from Aptaro
1) Can you provide a 2-week sampling of request timestamps (UTC) and a 7-day token histogram so we can run a simulated capacity test? (CSV acceptable)
2) Which auth/KMS pattern will you require for Dedicated? (Redwood-managed keys vs customer KMS in VPC).
3) Do you plan to run retrieval-store in the same VPC/network as model? If yes, we’ll include network egress estimations.

Next steps
- Marcus & I will finalize a formal Dedicated sizing stub + quoted price by EOD Thu (we've attached the pricing draft).
- If Aptaro wants to pilot Hosted first, we can provision a 2-week Hosted demo to validate traffic shape; we will present a delta analysis for Dedicated production.

Best,
Priyom Das
